justification: Although the case involves Article 11 assembly complaints, the Court disposes of them by a bare reference to well-established case-law without a standalone merits analysis, and the Article 11 findings are bundled together with Article 6 and Article 10 complaints in a single undifferentiated holding, meaning there is neither a single coherent Article 11 merits analysis nor a genuine standalone Article 11 merits adjudication.
